note: The header complement byte 0x20 matches no release; the nearest by bits is 0x6d, so that revision was used. The GameShark copied only the first 64 KiB of the 128 KiB flash; imported as mGBA does, the second half of the chip stays erased. The cart header in the file has bit errors ("P#K\x03M{" / "BPEJ"), as a GameShark reading through a poor cartridge contact gives; the release was taken from the readable part. With header bytes this damaged, the payload is damaged too: only 8 of the 14 sectors of the first copy pass their checksums, so the game reports the save erased.
